ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in Figure 1, it is known that point $D$ is the midpoint of line segment $AB$, and point $C$ is on line segment $AB$. If $AC=8\,\text{cm}$ and $BC=6\,\text{cm}$, what is the length of line segment $CD$ in cm?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $AC=8\text{cm}, BC=6\text{cm}$,\\
it follows that $AB=AC+BC=8+6=14\text{cm}$,\\
since point D is the midpoint of the line segment $AB$,\\
we have $BD=\frac{1}{2}AB=\frac{1}{2}\times 14=7\text{cm}$.\\
Since $CD=BD-BC$,\\
we conclude that $CD=7-6=\boxed{1}\text{cm}$.
